description: This file is a shell script used for testing a version control system, specifically Git. It includes test descriptions, source of external test libraries, setup of test data such as object identifiers and expected diff outputs, and several test cases that verify the correctness of diff operations between various tree states and objects within the repository.

methods.name: cmp_diff_files_output
methods.description: Normalizes object IDs in diff output and compares it with expected output to verify correctness of diff files.
